title: Have got & have: possession · have got 与 have
pattern: Subject + have / has got + noun · Subject + have / has + noun
summary: have got 和 have 都表示“有”；have got 偏口语，have 更通用。
explanation: 中文“有”在英语里有两种常见说法：**have got / has got** 和 **have / has**。两者意思相同，都表示拥有、关系或特征。have got 更口语，英式英语中很常见；have 更通用。I have a bike. 和 I've got a bike. 意思一样。
have got 的形式：I、you、we、they 用 have got，he、she、it 用 has got。缩写是 I've got、she's got（注意这个 's 也可能是 is，要看上下文）。否定形式是 haven't got / hasn't got：We haven't got any milk.
疑问句把 have 或 has 提到主语前面：Have you got a pen? / Has she got a car? 回答时用 Yes, I have. / No, she hasn't.
用 **have** 作普通动词时，否定和疑问要借助 do / does：I don't have a car. / Do you have a pen? 第三人称单数要用 does 和 has：Does he have a computer? 美式口语中 have 的疑问句通常用 do。
have 还有很多日常用法，比如 have breakfast（吃早饭）、have a shower（洗澡）、have a good time（玩得开心）。这些 have 不表示“拥有”，不能换成 have got。
mistakes: ✗ She have got a dog. → ✓ She has got a dog. 第三人称单数要用 has，不用 have。
✗ I don't have got a book. → ✓ I haven't got a book. have got 的否定是 haven't got，不要再加 don't。
✗ I have got breakfast at seven. → ✓ I have breakfast at seven. 吃早饭这类 have 的日常用法不表示拥有，不能用 have got。
✗ Have you a pen? (美式口语) → ✓ Do you have a pen? 在美式口语中，have 作实义动词时要用 do 来构成疑问句。

examples.text: Do you have a pen I can use?

examples.note: 这里的 have 不表示拥有。
